description: This file defines the SugarFieldMultienum class, which extends the SugarFieldEnum class, and provides methods for handling multi-enum fields in the SuiteCRM/SugarCRM system. It includes setup, display, save, and import sanitization functions specific to multi-enum field types.

classes.name: SugarFieldMultienum
classes.description: Represents a multi-enum field type, extending from SugarFieldEnum, with additional handling for multi-select options and import sanitization.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Initializes the multi-enum field, setting options_list if options are provided, and flags for workflow call if applicable.

methods.name: getSearchViewSmarty
methods.description: Returns the Smarty template for search view, choosing between HTML and standard search templates based on function return type.

methods.name: displayFromFunc
methods.description: Calls specific display functions based on display type and function return type, supporting flexible rendering.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Saves the multi-enum field values into the bean, handling multiselect logic and encoding multiple selections.

methods.name: importSanitize
methods.description: Sanitizes and encodes imported multi-enum values, ensuring validity of imported data.
